results.title: Ghana Cancels 10 Passports Issued Illegally After Applicants Allegedly Paid Up To $29,000, Suspends Two Officials - Sahara Reporters
results.snippet: Ghana’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs has cancelled 10 service passports allegedly issued illegally to individuals who did not qualify for them after paying members of a suspected criminal syndicate, as part of an investigation into a passport-for-sale scheme dating back to 2023. The ministry also announced the interdiction of two officials, including the Acting Director of Passports, Mahama Yahaya
